title: [bundle] Fix remaining executable doc-sync contradictions in test/PRD
objective: Fix remaining executable doc-sync contradictions in test/PRD docs: docs still show non-live hf policy check --command, hf drift --path, and hf mcp serve examples even though current hf either rejects them or ignores the argument. Update those docs to current implemented policy/drift/MCP surfaces, and prove the stale examples no longer appear while live replacement help commands work.
acceptance_criteria: Docs no longer present hf policy check --command, hf drift --path, hf mcp serve, or hf checkpoint --note as live runnable examples.

Replacement docs point to current live surfaces: hf policy check-claim/check-edit/check-handoff or hf policy gate, hf drift without path flags, hf-mcp for MCP serving if applicable, and hf checkpoint ID "note".
Live replacement help commands exit 0 and stale command probes demonstrate the old examples were invalid or misleading.
Changes stay within docs and handoff evidence scope.
test_commands: ! rg -n 'hf (policy check --command|drift --path|mcp serve|checkpoint --note)' docs FLEET_GUIDE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md .claude -g '*.md'
hf help policy >/tmp/hf-help-policy.out && rg -q "check-claim" /tmp/hf-help-policy.out && hf help drift >/tmp/hf-help-drift.out && rg -q "usage: hf drift" /tmp/hf-help-drift.out
hf policy check --command "docker run" >/tmp/hf-policy-stale.out 2>/tmp/hf-policy-stale.err; test $? -eq 2; rg -q "unknown command|unknown" /tmp/hf-policy-stale.err
hf mcp serve >/tmp/hf-mcp-stale.out 2>/tmp/hf-mcp-stale.err; test $? -eq 2; rg -q "unknown command.*mcp" /tmp/hf-mcp-stale.err
hf checkpoint --note x >/tmp/hf-checkpoint-note-stale.out 2>/tmp/hf-checkpoint-note-stale.err; test $? -ne 0; rg -q "task x not found|usage|unknown" /tmp/hf-checkpoint-note-stale.err
